color.note: Neutral-first: slate header, white cards on a cool grey page. Colour is spent on three things only — the blue action, the red STOP, and status tints that appear when something is abnormal. Joint hues identify joints, never status.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the cards and the 12px gutters between them. Text on it: `text` (13.0:1) or `muted` (5.7:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the status bar row, table bodies, the 3D viewport. Default ground for `text` (14.8:1) and `muted` (6.5:1).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet secondary fill: pipeline strip, table header, the read-only command preview, unselected segmented items, stale value cells. `text` and `muted` (6.1:1) both read on it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px outline of cards, chips, camera tiles and the status-bar divider. Decorative only (1.5:1) — never the only edge of a control; controls use `border-control`.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside the joint table and task list; chart grid lines; limit-bar track.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of interactive controls — select, checkbox, secondary button, segmented control — so the control edge meets 3:1 on `surface` (3.7:1), `surface-2` (3.4:1) and `info-bg` (3.2:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on `surface`, `surface-2`, `bg`, `info-bg` and every status `-bg` (all ≥ 12.8:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, units, captions, chip labels, axis ticks, timestamps. On `surface` 6.5:1, `surface-2` 6.1:1, `bg` 5.7:1, `info-bg` 5.6:1. Also the label colour of a disabled button on `disabled-bg`.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Top header bar behind STOP, tabs, project name and the VI·EN toggle; also the camera tile ground.

tokens.name: header-raised
tokens.usage: Active header tab and hovered header controls.

tokens.name: header-line
tokens.usage: Dividers and outlines inside the header (decorative).

tokens.name: on-header
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `header` (14.5:1) and `header-raised` (11.6:1).

tokens.name: on-header-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive tabs and the project subtitle on `header` (8.1:1) and `header-raised` (7.0:1); camera placeholder text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons (Send command, Ready), the selected-tab underline, links, the focus ring, the commanded ghost and the planned path in 3D. As text only on `surface` (4.6:1) — on `info-bg` it drops to 4.0:1, so blue text on a tint uses `info-text`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of a primary button (white label 6.5:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a `primary` fill (4.6:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour; used through the `focus-ring` shadow (2px `surface` gap + 2px ring) so it shows on light cards and on the dark header alike.

tokens.name: ok-text
tokens.usage: OK status text and icon on `ok-bg` (5.8:1) or `surface` (6.5:1). Green appears only on the overall lamp when everything is fine and on Done states — detail chips stay neutral when normal.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the OK lamp, Done task status and completed stepper chips.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: 1px outline of an OK chip (decorative; the icon and word carry the meaning).

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Attention level: text and icon on `warn-bg` (6.4:1) or `surface` (7.1:1). Slow tracking, near-limit joints, frozen camera, stale data, stop not yet confirmed.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of Attention chips, the warning banner and near-limit zones of the limit bar.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: 1px outline of Attention chips and banners (decorative).

tokens.name: critical-text
tokens.usage: Needs-action level: text and icon on `critical-bg` (5.7:1) or `surface` (6.6:1). Robot error, USB lost, disconnected, failed task, rejected command (NACK), failed pipeline step.

tokens.name: critical-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of Needs-action chips, the error banner and a failed pipeline step.

tokens.name: critical-line
tokens.usage: 1px outline of Needs-action chips and the error banner (decorative).

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Waiting-for-user level and the 'running' state: text and icon on `info-bg` (5.8:1) or `surface` (6.6:1). Also the label of a selected segmented item.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of Waiting-for-user chips, the running task card, the selected segmented item, the selected joint row and the first-visit hint.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: 1px outline of info chips and of the pinned running task (decorative).

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: STOP button fill (white bold label 5.0:1) and the Emergency-stop lamp. Reserved: no other control is red.

tokens.name: stop-hover
tokens.usage: STOP hover/pressed fill and the 'Stopped' state fill (white 6.6:1).

tokens.name: stop-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim of the STOP button so its edge reads on the dark header (6.8:1 on `header`; the red fill alone is 2.9:1 there).

tokens.name: on-stop
tokens.usage: STOP label and icon on `stop` and `stop-hover`.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled button (e.g. Send while a task runs). Its label is `muted`; the reason is always written underneath in `muted`.

tokens.name: joint-shoulder_pan
tokens.usage: shoulder_pan: swatch in the joint table, chart lines, 3D highlight tint. 5.2:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: joint-shoulder_lift
tokens.usage: shoulder_lift: swatch, chart lines, 3D tint. FLAG: 2.9:1 on `surface`, just under the 3:1 floor for chart lines — kept exact from the spec; the joint is never identified by colour alone (name in legend and table). If the hardware team agrees, #c2650a (4.1:1) is the drop-in fix.

tokens.name: joint-elbow_flex
tokens.usage: elbow_flex: swatch, chart lines, 3D tint. 3.7:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: joint-wrist_flex
tokens.usage: wrist_flex: swatch, chart lines, 3D tint. 5.7:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: joint-wrist_roll
tokens.usage: wrist_roll: swatch, chart lines, 3D tint. 4.6:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: joint-gripper
tokens.usage: gripper: swatch, chart lines, 3D tint. 4.8:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: robot-body
tokens.usage: Base colour of the measured (solid) robot's links before lighting; 3.7:1 on `surface` so the silhouette holds.

tokens.name: robot-ghost
tokens.usage: Commanded ghost robot, drawn at `opacity-ghost`.

tokens.name: ee-trail
tokens.usage: End-effector trail of the last 10 s, dotted, fading from full to `opacity-trail-min` with age.

tokens.name: planned-path
tokens.usage: Planned path, dashed 6/4.

tokens.name: viewport-floor
tokens.usage: Floor plane of the 3D scene.

tokens.name: viewport-grid
tokens.usage: Floor grid lines in the 3D scene.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal grid lines in trajectory charts.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart frame and the zero line.

tokens.name: camera-bg
tokens.usage: Camera tile ground while no frame is shown.

tokens.name: camera-text
tokens.usage: Placeholder label and icon on `camera-bg`.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip and popover fill.

tokens.name: on-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip text on `tooltip-bg` (14.8:1).

tokens.name: selected-bg
tokens.usage: Selected joint row, selected segmented item.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Base 14px, never below 11px. Sentence case everywhere except the STOP label.

styles.name: t-card-title
styles.usage: Card titles: Ra lệnh, Mô hình 3D, Trạng thái khớp…

styles.name: t-section
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a card (chart titles, banner title).

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Gắp vịt đỏ bỏ vào hộp
styles.usage: Default text: commands, list items, descriptions.

styles.name: t-body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; chip values.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Field labels, buttons, chips, segmented items, table headers.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.sample: Dựng từ URDF SO-101 theo vị trí đo của từng khớp
styles.usage: Card subtitles, helper and reason text, Vietnamese joint descriptions, legends.

styles.name: t-micro
styles.usage: The floor: tiny tags (estimated, stale) and 3D labels. Never smaller.

styles.name: t-stop
styles.usage: The STOP button label only, uppercase, `on-stop`.

groups.name: Tutorial
groups.note: Reading text for the Tutorial tab.

styles.name: t-doc-body
styles.sample: Mỗi trạng thái luôn có biểu tượng và chữ, không chỉ màu.
styles.usage: Tutorial paragraphs, max 68 characters per line.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Every number, unit, id, joint name and millisecond is mono so columns line up.

styles.name: t-value
styles.usage: Joint table numbers, chip numbers, EE readout. Right-aligned in tables.

styles.name: t-value-strong
styles.usage: Technical joint names and task ids (#13).

styles.name: t-meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, durations, ms per pipeline step, FPS and frame age.

styles.name: t-command
styles.sample: pick the red duck and put it in the box

spacing.note: 4px base. Cards sit 12px apart on `bg`; content inside a card is padded 16px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, swatch-to-name gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between stacked fields' label and control, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and page gutter; task item padding; status bar vertical padding is space-2.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, header horizontal padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's sections (form → stepper).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tutorial section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tutorial page margins.

radius.note: Small and calm: 6–8px. No pills except status dots.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, joint swatches, limit bar, micro tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips, segmented controls, task items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, camera tiles, the 3D viewport.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the live indicator only.

shadow.note: Flat UI: borders, not shadows. The only shadow is on floating popovers; the focus ring is a box-shadow so it follows the radius.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Tooltips, select menus, the dev scenario panel — anything floating.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control (STOP included): a 2px white gap then 2px solid `primary` — ≥ 4:1 on `surface`, `bg`, `surface-2`, and the white gap carries it on the dark header.

size.note: Fixed layout measures from the spec (desktop target 1440 × 900, fluid).

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Header bar height.

tokens.name: size-stop
tokens.usage: STOP button height (never less) and its minimum width is 120px.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: Select and input height.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: The Send command button.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Joint table row height (two-line joint cell).

tokens.name: col-left
tokens.usage: Left column: Command card, Task history.

tokens.name: col-right
tokens.usage: Right column: Joint table, Trajectory charts.

tokens.name: viewer-height
tokens.usage: 3D viewport height.

tokens.name: camera-height
tokens.usage: Camera image area height.

tokens.name: bp-stack
tokens.usage: Below this width the three columns stack.

opacity.note: Used for 3D and charts only; never on text (dimmed text would fall under 4.5:1).

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Commanded ghost robot.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Other joints' lines and meshes while one joint row is selected.

tokens.name: opacity-trail-min
tokens.usage: Oldest end of the 10 s end-effector trail.
